## 二、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与商业流程）

### 2.1 关键财务数据

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY 变化（GAAP） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $37,847M | $33,112M | **+14%** | press_release.txt Business Highlights；financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 营业成本 | $6,989M | $6,042M | +15.7%（约 +14%） | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $8,958M | $8,077M | +11% | 同上 |
| 营业利润 | $21,900M | $18,993M | **+15%** | 同上 |
| 经营利润率 | **57.9%** | 57.3% | +0.6pp | 21,900 / 37,847 测算；transcript.txt："operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%" |

### 2.2 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

1. **Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 收入**：报告口径增长 14%，调整后（剔除上年同期 2 个百分点 in-period 收入确认有利比较）增长 16%（press_release.txt Business Highlights；transcript.txt Amy Hood："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."）
2. **M365 Commercial 产品收入**：增长 19%，由长期 M365 合同导致 Windows Commercial on-premises 组件在本期确认更多收入（transcript.txt Amy Hood："M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."）
3. **M365 Consumer cloud**：增长 24%（恒汇率 22%），由 ARPU 增长驱动，订阅数增长 7%（transcript.txt："M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."）
4. **LinkedIn**：增长 12%（恒汇率 10%），主要由 Marketing Solutions 驱动（transcript.txt："LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."）
5. **Dynamics 365**：增长 13%（恒汇率 12%），ERP 订单增长稳健，CRM 因销售周期延长有所放缓（transcript.txt："Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."）
6. **分部毛利率**：分部毛利率美元增长 14%，毛利率百分比小幅下降，原因是 M365 Copilot 使用量增加（transcript.txt："Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage."）
7. **经营费用**：增长 11%，主要由共享 R&D 投资驱动（transcript.txt："Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier."）

## 三、分部二：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

### 3.1 关键财务数据

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY 变化（GAAP） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $39,306M | $29,878M | **+32%** | press_release.txt Business Highlights；financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 营业成本 | $16,876M | $11,845M | +42.5% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $6,475M | $5,893M | +10% | 同上 |
| 营业利润 | $15,955M | $12,140M | **+31%** | 同上 |
| 经营利润率 | **40.6%** | 40.7% | -0.1pp（基本持平） | 15,955 / 39,306 测算；transcript.txt："operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%" |

### 3.2 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

1. **Azure 及其他云服务**：增长 43%（恒汇率 43%）。客户需求持续超过可用产能，增长超预期，得益于 CPU/GPU 机队效率提升和新产能提前交付；同时 6 月业务模式调整为按用量定价后，GitHub Copilot 消耗收入超预期（transcript.txt Amy Hood："In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."）
2. **本地服务器业务**：收入基本持平，恒汇率 -1%，主要由合同组合 renewals 的 in-period 收入确认改善驱动（transcript.txt："In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."）
3. **分部毛利率**：毛利率美元增长 24%，毛利率百分比下降，原因是 Azure 销售占比上升（sales mix shift）以及 AI 基础设施持续扩展；GitHub Copilot 使用量增长也产生影响，但本季度因按用量定价调整后毛利率有所改善（transcript.txt："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."）
4. **经营费用**：增长 10%，由共享 R&D 投资驱动（transcript.txt："Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."）

## 四、分部三：More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

### 4.1 关键财务数据

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY 变化（GAAP） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $12,854M | $13,451M | **-4%** | press_release.txt Business Highlights；financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 营业成本 | $5,660M | $6,127M | -7.6%（约 -2%） | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $4,446M | $4,134M | +8% | 同上 |
| 营业利润 | $2,748M | $3,190M | **-14%** | 同上 |
| 经营利润率 | **21.4%** | 23.7% | -2.3pp | 2,748 / 12,854 测算；transcript.txt："operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%" |

### 4.2 下滑驱动因素（引用原文）

1. **Windows OEM and Devices**：收入下降 7%，其中 Windows OEM 下降 5%，原因为 PC 市场需求疲软以及上一个财年 Windows 10 结束支持形成的高基数比较。渠道伙伴因组件价格上涨继续建立库存，表现好于预期（transcript.txt Amy Hood："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."）
2. **搜索广告（剔除 TAC）**：增长 10%（恒汇率 9%），由 Edge 和 Bing 每搜索收入提高及搜索量增长驱动，但受到第三方合作影响（transcript.txt："Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."）
3. **XBOX 内容与服务**：收入下降 10%（恒汇率 11%），上一财年同期受益于第一方内容强劲表现形成高基数（transcript.txt："XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."）
4. **分部毛利率**：毛利率美元下降 2%，但毛利率百分比上升，因为 Activision 收购的摊销减少（transcript.txt："Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."）
5. **经营费用**：增长 8%（恒汇率 7%），由共享 R&D 投资和 XBOX 减值共同驱动（transcript.txt："Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."）
6. **Satya Nadella 在 XBOX 战略上的表态**：本季度做出"必要决策"，对内容组合、平台和运营进行 reset，预期 FY27 恢复增长（transcript.txt Satya Nadella："When it comes to XBOX, we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth. We have the best IP in the industry, and talented studios around the world, and believe we can bring these strengths together and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."）

## 七、口径提示（读者注意事项）

1. **分部收入 ≠ 全公司收入加总**：本报告分部数字来自 financial_statements.txt Segment Results 工作表，已与全公司合并数勾稽一致。
2. **经营利润率不可跨分部直接比较**：各分部成本结构和业务模式差异显著（如 IC 分部毛利率显著低于 P&BP），分部利润率仅反映分部自身盈利能力。
3. **恒汇率增长与报告口径增长的区别**：当汇率波动较大时，两者差异可达数个百分点（如 MPC 本季 -4% vs -5%恒汇率）。跨分部比较时建议统一使用同一种口径。
4. **成本数据未在 press_release.txt 中按分部披露**，需从 financial_statements.txt Segment Results 工作表读取（本报告已采用）。
5. **非 GAAP 调整仅影响公司层面**：OpenAI 投资调整在 press_release.txt 与 transcript.txt 中说明，但不影响分部收入和分部营业利润的披露数字（分部数据均为 GAAP）。
6. **FY27 指引中分部收入为前导区间**，本报告 FY26 Q4 数据为实际值，两者不可直接对比使用。
7. **Microsoft Cloud 收入（$59.3B）跨越多个分部**（主要含 Azure/IC 部分 + M365 Commercial cloud 等 P&BP 部分），因此不能简单归属于某一单一分部。
8. **"经营费用"在微软分部披露中包含 R&D、销售与市场、以及部分共享 G&A**，不包含成本 of revenue（COGS），与全公司口径一致。
